page.layout: One page of running text with marginal notes in the right margin. Top: a fragment of verse ("& arma") and a verse stanza, indented. Below: two paragraphs of prose, the second with a black-letter-free italic passage and a right margin note. Foot: signature "P 2". Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.l: Deniq; sic præ me semper tuli, si Iesuitæ
ne-gotio huic se immiscerent, nullum eius bonū
euentum expectandum, hos enim omnia tur-
baturos. Et si res felicissimè cadat, Imperium
illud ab ipsis perturbatum & motibus intesti-
nis repletum iri, qui nobis tempore fortassis
non æquissimo negotium facessere possent,
quemadmodum in Suecia nobis non ita dudū a-
ccidit. Quàm verus autem & falsus in his o-
mnibus fuerim, ipsum tempus reuelabit, & tum
nos etiam de Iesuitarum in conuertendis bar-
baris studio rectius poterimus iudicare.
Religionis Conseruatrici propagationi sub-
iungitur Instituendæ iuuentutis nescio quod occul-
tum & exoticum artificium, propter quod Ref[?]-
pub.(si vtiq; Ecclesia iacturam hanc negligere
posset) Iesuitarum opera carere nullo modo
queat. Et hic prætextus superioribus æstima-
tionis pondere non multum cedit, cuius tamē
vanitatem viri in omni disciplinarum genere
exercitatissimi, qui Romano-Catholicam re-
ligionē publicē profitentur & defendunt, iam
dudum Orbi demonstrarunt. Rationibus fir-
missimis cuidenter oftendentes: Iesuitas pri-
mum & Iesuitarum Institutum bonis litteris
& earum reflorescenti splendori plus offuisse;

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "uncta" in the first verse line (the letter over the c is unclear, possibly an abbreviation); "Ref-" at the line end, probably Resp. with a damaged s; the page number "125" is partly worn. Long s is written as s throughout. The margin note's line breaks are not reproduced. Italic passages: "Religionis", "Instituendæ iuuentutis nescio quod occultum & exoticum artificium", the verse, and "& arma". The left margin shows only a stain and a mark, not text.
